definitions: To be lost in daydreaming or fantasy.
To be unaware of what is happening around you.
examples: She always has her head in the clouds during meetings.
He's a brilliant artist, but he often has his head in the clouds when it comes to finances.
If you have your head in the clouds, you might miss important details.
lemma: to have your head in the clouds
synonyms: to be out of touch with reality
source: to have your head in the clouds
